items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Stops Agents Messaging for Requesters
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.246, removing agents’ ability to send messages on a requester’s behalf. Agent messages are no longer attributed to the requester, making message ownership easier to distinguish.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 移除 Agent 代用戶發訊功能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat 是開源 AI 聊天平台；CLI v0.0.246 移除 Agent 代用戶發訊功能。過去代理可代表請求者發訊，現在不再以對方名義發送，令訊息來源更清楚。同類選擇可留意其他支援 Agent 頻道的工具。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Fixes Shared Agent Attachments
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an AI chat platform, has fixed shared Agent messaging in v0.0.245 so visitors can attach files. Previously, these messages appeared unsent; now uploads follow the share page’s limits and are readable by the Agent owner’s run, with a clear explanation if the limit is exceeded.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 共享Agent支援訪客附件
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（AI平台）修正共享Agent附件功能，訪客現可為訊息附上檔案。過往會顯示未送出；現會按分享頁面限制上載，讓Agent擁有者讀到訪客檔案，超限亦會在訊息下清楚解釋原因。同類選擇亦可比較ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Hy4 Flash
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference engine, added Hy4 Flash support to its DSA iSWA cache path, including sparse and sliding-window attention layers. Users can now experiment with the Tencent model locally through this implementation.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新增 Hy4 Flash 支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源推論工具）加入 Tencent Hy4 Flash 的 DSA iSWA cache 支援，涵蓋稀疏及滑動窗注意力。用戶過往要測試這種架構須另覓支援，現可在本機試跑；同類工具可選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: Rust 0.174a7
items.summary_en: Rust, a systems programming language, released version 0.174.0-alpha.7.
items.headline_zh: Rust 0.174.0-alpha.7 測試版
items.summary_zh: Rust（系統程式設計語言）發布 v0.174.0-alpha.7 測試版，讓開發者提前接觸新版；官方未交代具體變更。過往要等正式版，現可提早測試相容性及規劃升級；想求穩定可改看 Rust 穩定版。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp updates OpenVINO decoding
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running language models locally, updates ggml-openvino to fix CI operation tests and improve KV-cache decoding. Users of its OpenVINO backend may see more reliable tests and better decoding performance.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 改善 OpenVINO 解碼
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地跑語言模型的開源框架）更新其 OpenVINO 後端，修正運算測試與 KV cache 解碼。過往就地節點未寫回可令 CI 失敗；更新後用戶可望改善解碼效率，同類可選 ONNX Runtime。

items.headline_en: LobeChat v0.0.244 Adds Compression Divider
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.244 with conversation compression positions shown as dividers and a scrollable section. Users can now spot compressed sections more easily instead of checking through long chats section by section.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新版加入對話壓縮分隔線
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）發布 v0.0.244，用分隔線顯示對話中的壓縮位置，並加入可捲動區域。以前要逐段確認哪些內容已被壓縮，現在靠分隔線即可辨認，閱讀長對話時較省力。同類有 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI adds credentials for device agents
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, the command-line tool for the open-source LobeChat AI chat platform, released v0.0.243 with device agent credentials and an optional business settings tab. The update gives CLI users a direct way to configure device authentication and business options.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 新增裝置代理憑證
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（LobeChat 命令行工具）發布 v0.0.243，新增裝置代理憑證與可選商務設定分頁。過往或需分開處理裝置認證與商務選項，現可於 CLI 設定，減少配置步驟；同類如 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: 歸藏 MAGI-2 Skill：打通 Video to Code（视频转一镜到底交互网页）与 Code to Video（代码动作预演控制 AI 视频）的 Agent Skill，内置 MAGI-2 提示词优化与 Lib
items.summary_en: op7418/guizang-magi2-skill - 歸藏 MAGI-2 Skill：打通 Video to Code（视频转一镜到底交互网页）与 Code to Video（代码动作预演控制 AI 视频）的 Agent Skill，内置 MAGI-2 提示词优化与 LibTV MCP 修复。AI Agent Skill for Antigravity, Claude Code & Codex. Gained 40 GitHub stars in 1 days (~50/day).

items.headline_en: Persistent Agent runs background work
items.summary_en: Persistent Agent is a proactive, always-on, goal-oriented agent sample from LangChain for enterprise use, with memory, browser use, hundreds of tools, and background playbooks; it gained 65 GitHub stars in one day. Users can delegate tasks instead of giving each instruction and waiting, while other LangChain agent samples offer similar alternatives.
items.headline_zh: Persistent Agent 支援後台自主辦事
items.summary_zh: Persistent Agent 是LangChain的AI代理範例，支援記憶、瀏覽器及數百項工具，可按目標在後台辦事。GitHub一日獲65星。用戶毋須指示或守候，可交它推進任務；同類有LangChain agent範例。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Adds Project Management
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI released v0.0.242 with project features for managing project runners and environment settings. Users can handle these configurations through the command line, making project setup more centralized and convenient.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 加入專案管理功能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（LobeChat 命令列工具）發布 v0.0.242，新增專案功能，可管理專案的 runners 與環境設定。用戶毋須四處查找配置，設定流程更集中省時。同類選擇可考慮 Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: Mistral Services Return to Normal
items.summary_en: Mistral’s status page now shows all systems operational, confirming that the earlier issue has been resolved. Users can once again use its services without working around the earlier disruption.
items.headline_zh: Mistral 服務恢復正常
items.summary_zh: Mistral（AI 模型與服務供應商）的狀態頁現顯示所有系統運作正常，先前故障已解決。用戶毋須再處理服務中斷造成的等待或無法使用問題，可直接照常使用相關服務。同類選擇包括 OpenAI、Google Gemini。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Metaspace Support for BPE
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source AI inference framework, added support for always prepending Metaspace in BPE vocabularies in release b12751. Users running BPE-based models can apply the required text formatting automatically instead of handling it separately during preprocessing.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 為 BPE 加入 Metaspace 支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源 AI 推論框架）在 b12751 版本中，為 BPE 詞彙表實作 Metaspace prepend_scheme always，並移除 test-tokenizer-mmbert 測試。採用 BPE 的模型現可自動處理 Metaspace 前綴，用戶毋須另行處理文字預處理；底層愛潑客未必有感。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Graceful Windows Shutdown
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source tool for running large language models locally, now lets its llama-server shut down cleanly on Windows when it receives CTRL_BREAK_EVENT. Scripts that launch the server can request a graceful stop instead of force-killing it; LM Studio is another local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增Windows正常關閉
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推理工具）讓Windows的llama-server收到CTRL_BREAK_EVENT時乾淨關閉。過往腳本只能強制結束伺服器，現可正常停止；同類工具可選LM Studio。

items.headline_en: Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Brai
items.summary_en: alesha-pro/llm.asm - Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Braille TUI (32 KB) in 100% pure x86-64 NASM assembly. Zero C, zero libc, zero dependencies. Gained 418 GitHub stars in 1 days (~489/day).

items.headline_en: UX Pilot designs and builds UIs
items.summary_en: UX Pilot is a free frontend design skill for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It designs an interface on a UX Pilot canvas and then builds it in your codebase, giving developers a shorter path from visual plan to working code; it gained 151 GitHub stars on its first day.
items.headline_zh: UX Pilot 免費技能打造前端介面
items.summary_zh: UX Pilot 係 Claude Code、Codex 同 Cursor 嘅免費前端設計技能，可喺畫布設計介面，再喺程式碼建立成品。以前畫稿再實作，而家可接連處理，慳時間；首日錄得151 stars。同類可選 v0。

items.headline_en: Session rotation suite for ALL AI services — one binary.
items.summary_en: dxu1570/ai-session-suite - Session rotation suite for ALL AI services — one binary. Gained 66 GitHub stars in 0 days (~132/day).

items.headline_en: LangChain Core 1.8.5 reuses provider message IDs across stream chunks
items.summary_en: LangChain Core (the core package of the LLM application framework) released 1.8.5, reusing provider message IDs on later streamed chunks and clarifying v3 runtime-warning behavior and supported streaming-event APIs. Developers can now carry the same provider ID through later chunks, reducing ID reconciliation when processing streamed output.
items.headline_zh: LangChain-core 修正串流ID一致性
items.summary_zh: LangChain-core（LangChain 的LLM應用框架核心）發布1.8.5：串流後續區塊沿用供應商訊息ID，並更新v3執行期警告與串流事件API文件。過往開發者須處理ID不一致，現可簡化串接；或用供應商SDK。

items.headline_en: LangChain-Anthropic Supports Custom Clients
items.summary_en: LangChain-Anthropic, a LangChain integration for Anthropic’s Claude models, released version 1.7.13 with support for custom HTTP and SDK clients. Users can now tailor client handling to their own setup instead of being limited to the package’s default behavior.
items.headline_zh: Anthropic 整合新增自訂客戶端
items.summary_zh: LangChain-Anthropic 是 LangChain 的 Claude 整合套件，1.7.13 支援自訂 HTTP、SDK 用戶端。過往須用預設客戶端，現可按環境配置，更易整合基建；同類尚有 LiteLLM。

items.summary_en: LangGraph CLI 0.4.44 adds deployment URLs to deploy list --json, supports BYOC data-plane deployments using only an API key, and omits empty secrets lists when updating deployments. Developers can now inspect deployment details more directly and set up BYOC deployments with less configuration.
items.headline_zh: LangGraph CLI 0.4.44 更新
items.summary_zh: LangGraph CLI（部署工具）deploy list --json 加入網址，支援只用 API key 發布 BYOC 數據平面。以往缺部署網址，現時查得更直接、BYOC 設定更精簡；同類可選 Docker。

items.headline_en: Claude Code Unlimited Combines LLMs
items.summary_en: tDupuis19341/claude-session-rotator - Claude Code Unlimited — claude-code and llm in one tool. Gained 66 GitHub stars in 0 days (~132/day).
items.headline_zh: Claude Code Unlimited整合多款LLM
items.summary_zh: Claude Code Unlimited 是將Claude Code與其他大型語言模型整合於同一工具的開源專案，可輪換Claude工作階段。用戶毋須逐一切換服務或重做設定，更方便按需要比較模型表現；同類選擇有Claude Code Router。專案在GitHub獲得66個星。

items.headline_en: AI Old Photo Animate — animate and animation in one tool.
items.summary_en: matsumoto4039/old-photo-life - AI Old Photo Animate — animate and animation in one tool. Gained 66 GitHub stars in 0 days (~132/day).

items.headline_en: AI VTuber Toolkit Combines AI and Avatars
items.summary_en: AI VTuber Toolkit is a GitHub project that combines AI and virtual avatars in one tool. Creators can keep the two elements in a single project instead of assembling separate tools.
items.headline_zh: AI VTuber Toolkit整合AI和頭像
items.summary_zh: AI VTuber Toolkit是GitHub上的VTuber工具，將AI和虛擬角色合為一體。創作者以往要分別尋找AI與角色方案，現可在一個項目內組合兩者，減少工具拼接；同類選擇亦可用獨立的AI與Live2D工具。

items.headline_en: LiteLLM v1.108.18 merges an LTS backport
items.summary_en: LiteLLM, an open-source gateway for unified access to language-model APIs, released v1.108.18, merging PR #54323 to backport a change to the 1.1 LTS branch. Users on that line can receive the backport through the release instead of handling it separately.
items.headline_zh: LiteLLM 1.108.18 合併回補
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM 是統一呼叫語言模型 API 的開源閘道；1.108.18 合併 PR #54323，將改動回補至 1.1 LTS 分支。用戶毋須自行處理差異，可隨長期支援線取得回補；同類選擇有 OpenRouter。

items.headline_en: Codex CLI 0.174.0-alpha.6 Released
items.summary_en: Codex CLI, OpenAI's AI coding agent that helps developers write and modify code, released version 0.174.0-alpha.6.
items.headline_zh: Codex 發布 0.174.0-alpha.6
items.summary_zh: Codex CLI 是 AI 程式開發代理，可協助編寫及修改程式碼，並推出 0.174.0-alpha.6。開發者能依版本號確認更新，但資料未列功能變更，效益暫難判斷；同類亦可比較 GitHub Copilot。

items.headline_en: Scientists Set Boundaries for AI Agents
items.summary_en: Hugging Face Blog, a publication on AI models and open-source tools, published an article examining where scientists draw the line on AI agents. It helps readers understand the grounds scientists use to accept or restrict autonomous behavior rather than relying only on product marketing; a related policy reference is Anthropic’s Responsible Scaling Policy.
items.headline_zh: 科學家如何劃定AI代理界線
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face Blog（AI模型與開源工具部落格）刊文，探討科學家如何劃定AI代理界線。讀者可了解科學家接受或限制自主行為的依據，毋須只憑產品宣傳；同類可參考Anthropic的負責任擴展政策。

items.headline_en: CUDA Update
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference tool, refactored and deduplicated FlashAttention data loading in its CUDA backend. It also fixes float2 indexing and HIP quality-check handling, so users of those GPU backends get a cleaner path instead of the previous duplicated implementation with the indexing issue.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 CUDA 資料載入
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源模型推論工具）重整 CUDA 的 FlashAttention 資料載入，去重並修正 float2 索引、HIP 品質檢查。GPU 用戶可用精簡流程，取代重複及錯誤索引實作；同類選 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Stops Duplicate Plugin Writes
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, a command-line AI tool, has released v0.0.241 with a fix that prevents the same tool output from being written twice into plugin storage. Users can avoid redundant storage writes and repeated processing when tools save results.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正插件重複寫入
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（命令列 AI 工具）推出 v0.0.241，避免相同工具輸出重複寫入插件儲存區。以前工具結果可能寫兩遍，現在只寫一次，可減少冗餘儲存與重複處理。同類命令列 AI 工具可選 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI skips excluded tool payloads
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.240 with an agent-runtime update that skips tool payloads removed by projection. This avoids unnecessary payload processing during affected agent steps, reducing runtime overhead compared with the previous behavior.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI優化Agent工具處理
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI平台）發布CLI v0.0.240，Agent Runtime可略過投影流程已排除的工具資料。過去相關步驟會處理這些內容，現在能減少無效運算；同類可選Open WebUI。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Fixes ON_DEVICE Sequence Restoration
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference tool, fixed sequence-state restoration with ON_DEVICE in build b12753. On-device apps can now restore saved sequence state more reliably; Ollama is a similar local-inference option.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正裝置端序列還原
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 AI 推論工具）在 b12753 版修正 ON_DEVICE 模式的序列狀態還原。以前裝置端應用恢復已保存狀態可能出錯，現在可更可靠地接續工作；同類本地推論工具可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Reserved Scratch Memory
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, the open-source local-model inference framework, added reserved scratch memory to ggml graph optimization so several nodes can share data in a compute buffer. For local-model users, this lets a backend retain shared data until the final related node completes, potentially avoiding repeated allocations.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 新增暫存記憶體預留
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（本地推理框架）的ggml圖最佳化現可預留暫存記憶體，讓多個節點共用計算緩衝區。過去圖最佳化階段未能預留記憶體；現在後端可保留至最後節點完成，有助減少重複配置。同類方案如ONNX Runtime。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp releases version 1.1.0
items.summary_en: llama.cpp (an open-source tool for running large language models locally) released version 1.1.0. Users can move from the previous build to the new version, but should check the release notes because the announcement lists no specific features or fixes.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 發布 1.1.0 版本
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大語言模型執行框架）發布1.1.0版本，讓用戶可更新本機模型執行環境；惟公告只確認版本號上調，未列新增功能或修正。用戶毋須假設升級已有指定改善，應先查閱版本紀錄；同類選擇有Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds SYCL F8 Ops
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, added initial SYCL support for F8 e4m3 SET_ROWS, CPY, ADD, MUL_MAT and MUL_MAT_ID operations. SYCL users can now use these specific operations in llama.cpp where they were previously unsupported, though the implementation remains at an initial stage.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp新增SYCL F8運算支援
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地語言模型框架）為SYCL新增F8 e4m3初步支援，涵蓋SET_ROWS、CPY、ADD及矩陣乘法運算。SYCL用戶由運算未受支援，變成框架可處理；仍屬初期，亦可比較Ollama。

items.headline_en: LobeChat agents can now post cards via webhook
items.summary_en: LobeChat v0.0.239 adds a channel feature that lets agents post cards outside their normal replies via webhook. Users can surface agent cards separately instead of keeping them inside a chat reply; other webhook-capable agent platforms offer similar options.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 新增 Webhook 卡片發送
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）v0.0.239 新增 channel 功能，Agent 可透過 webhook 於回覆外發卡。用戶毋須再把卡片困在回覆內，可獨立展示產出；亦可比較同類 webhook 整合。

items.headline_en: OpenHands v1.46.0
items.summary_en: OpenHands, an open-source AI coding agent, released v1.46.0 with controls to list and unshare team conversations, submit feedback, and keep automation activation status local through a new Git Sync switch. Users gain more direct control over shared conversations, feedback, and local automation activation.
items.headline_zh: OpenHands v1.46.0新增三項功能
items.summary_zh: OpenHands（開源AI程式開發代理）發布v1.46.0，新增團隊對話列出及取消分享、回饋流程，以及保留本機啟用狀態的Git Sync開關。用戶過往較難整理共享對話，現可回報問題並管理自動化。同類如Cline。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Keeps One-Delivery Requests Visible
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.238 with a channel fix. One-delivery requests now remain on the timeline rather than being removed after delivery, so users can find and review them later.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 修正一次性訊息時間線
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天平台）發布 CLI v0.0.238，修正 channel 對一次性投遞請求的處理。這類請求會留在對話時間線，不再因完成投遞而消失，方便用戶稍後查找及回看；同類選擇可看 Chatbox。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI improves uploads
items.summary_en: LobeChat CLI, a command-line tool, released v0.0.237 with upload changes: stalled transfers now fail, and encoding runs off the main thread. Users get quicker feedback on stuck uploads and more responsive file handling.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 優化上傳效能
items.summary_zh: LobeChat CLI（命令列工具）v0.0.237 優化上傳：停滯傳送會直接報錯，編碼亦移離主執行緒。用戶以往可能因卡住而久等，現在失敗會更快顯示，操作亦較順。喜歡圖形介面的話，可考慮同類桌面或網頁客戶端。

items.headline_en: Cloudflare Launches Search for Agents
items.summary_en: Cloudflare, a cloud services platform, has launched Search for Agents, a toggle that automatically indexes site content, provides a discoverable search API, and natively supports HTTP QUERY. Site owners can now expose content to AI-agent search with one setting instead of separately assembling indexing and query access.
items.headline_zh: Cloudflare 推出代理搜尋功能
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare（雲端平台）推出 Search for Agents，一鍵啟用即可索引網站、開放搜尋 API，並支援 HTTP QUERY。營運者過往要自行整合介面，現可讓 AI 代理查找內容；同類選擇：自建搜尋 API。

items.headline_en: Copilot Service Recovers, All Systems Operational
items.summary_en: Copilot, an AI coding assistant, has returned to normal after an earlier service issue. Users can once again access its features as before.
items.headline_zh: Copilot 服務恢復正常
items.summary_zh: Copilot（AI 程式開發助手）的服務狀態已恢復正常，先前問題亦告解決。用戶現可如常使用相關功能，毋須再擔心服務中斷；若要替代方案，也可比較其他 AI 程式助手。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI v0.0.236 Released
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat framework, released CLI v0.0.236, removing the automatic 👀 and ✅ marks from Agent requests. Those requests previously carried both symbols automatically, so users now face less visual clutter in channels.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 移除 Agent 狀態標記
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）CLI 發布 v0.0.236，Agent 請求不再自動加上 👀及✅標記。過往頻道會附上狀態符號，現在少些視覺雜訊，使用者可專注實際內容。同類 Agent CLI 也是可比較選項。

items.headline_en: LobeChat CLI Aligns Project Environment Picker
items.summary_en: LobeChat released CLI v0.0.235, aligning the project execution-environment picker. The update makes environment selection more consistent for users configuring project runs.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 統一專案執行環境選擇器
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 聊天框架）發布 CLI v0.0.235，調整專案執行環境選擇器，讓相關選項的呈現與操作更一致。用戶配置專案執行環境時可減少理解落差；命令列開發工具亦可比較 Claude Code。

items.headline_en: GitHub Copilot reports degraded model performance
items.summary_en: GitHub Copilot, an AI coding assistant, reports minor degraded performance among its AI model providers on its status page. Users can check the status page before blaming their prompts if Copilot seems slow.
items.headline_zh: GitHub Copilot模型供應商效能下降
items.summary_zh: GitHub Copilot（AI 程式編寫助手）的狀態頁顯示，Copilot AI 模型供應商出現輕微效能下降。用戶若遇到回應變慢，可先查狀態頁，毋須立即怪罪提示詞；同類選擇可考慮 Cursor。

items.headline_en: ChatGPT service degradation
items.summary_en: ChatGPT, an AI chatbot, reported a minor partial system degradation on its status page. Users can check the status page before blaming their prompts, helping distinguish a platform issue from a prompt problem.
items.headline_zh: ChatGPT 部分系統降級
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT（AI 聊天助手）的狀態頁顯示，服務出現「輕微」及「部分系統降級」。過往遇到操作異常，用戶可能先怪提示詞；現可先查狀態頁，判斷問題來自平台抑或提示詞；同類選擇可包括 Claude 或 Gemini。

items.headline_en: Garimpo Automates Google Maps Prospecting
items.summary_en: Garimpo is an open-source Google Maps prospecting tool that finds businesses, creates a preview site for each, chats with them on WhatsApp, and accepts Pix, Mercado Pago, or Stripe payments before closing the sale automatically. For users, it replaces manual searching, site creation, follow-up, and payment handling; it can run on a PC, VPS, or Vercel with an API for Claude Code, Codex, and n8n, and gained 186 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: Garimpo打通Maps商家開發與收款
items.summary_zh: Garimpo 是開源 Google Maps 開發工具，可找商家、建立預覽網站、在 WhatsApp 跟進，可用 Pix 等方式收款並自動成交。過往逐家搜尋、跟進收款，現可自動處理並部署到 Vercel。同類可選 n8n。

items.headline_en: LobeChat releases PR test build
items.summary_en: LobeChat (open-source AI chat framework) released a development build for PR #23856. Developers can validate the PR changes in a desktop environment rather than use a production release, but features may be incomplete or unstable.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 發布 PR 測試版
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源AI聊天框架）發布nightly測試版，涵蓋PR #23856變更，僅供桌面環境驗證。開發者可測試指定改動而毋須採用正式版本，但功能可能未完成或不穩定，不宜投入生產；日常使用可選穩定版。

items.headline_en: Hugging Face Introduces CUGA Voice Agent
items.summary_en: Hugging Face introduced CUGA, a voice agent designed for Indic-language interaction. Developers can use the project as a reference when exploring voice experiences for those languages.
items.headline_zh: Hugging Face介紹CUGA語音代理
items.summary_zh: CUGA 是 Hugging Face 介紹的印度語系語音代理，可供開發者探索以語音進行相關語言互動。過往製作這類功能往往要自行整合各環節，現在則有現成項目可供參考，降低起步門檻；亦可比較其他印度語系語音代理。

items.headline_en: Fast local LLM inference on plain CPUs.
items.summary_en: opensetlabs/openset-llm - Fast local LLM inference on plain CPUs. No GPU, 8 GB of RAM. OpenAI-compatible server. Gained 954 GitHub stars in 13 days (~76/day).

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds A2UI Agent Cards
items.summary_en: LobeChat release v0.0.234 lets agents answer with A2UI cards in Topics and Channels. Users can read those replies in a card format instead of relying on plain text, making information easier to scan.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 加入 A2UI 卡片回覆
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 對話平台）讓代理在 Topics 和 Channel 以 A2UI 卡片回答。過往用戶要自行理解純文字回覆，現在卡片式答案更易閱讀；同類選擇可比較 OpenAI Apps SDK。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp changes Metal graph submission
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source AI inference framework, updated its Metal backend to commit computation graphs in chunks through a single command-buffer thread. Mac users move from submitting the whole graph at once to processing it in chunks, though no speed gain is quantified; a comparable local option is LM Studio.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 更新 Metal 圖提交方式
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源AI推論框架）更新Metal後端，把運算圖分批交由單一command buffer執行緒提交。Mac用戶由整圖一次提交改為分批處理；速度效益有待實測。同類選擇亦可試LM Studio。

items.headline_en: Open WebUI Adds Folder Workspaces
items.summary_en: Open WebUI, an open-source AI chat interface, added Folder workspaces in v0.13.5, letting users run project tests in a terminal and try the app in a browser beside the chat. Users can select a computer and project directory once, retain personal tabs and layouts in shared folders, and use the standalone Open WebUI Computer (cptr) workflow inside Open WebUI, with the standalone app still available.
items.headline_zh: Open WebUI 新增資料夾工作區
items.summary_zh: Open WebUI（開源AI聊天介面）新增資料夾工作區，選定電腦及專案目錄後，可在聊天旁用終端機跑測試，並在瀏覽器試用程式。過往須另用獨立 app，現已整合；共用資料夾可各留個人分頁與版面，亦可選 cptr app。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Async Input Copies
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, released a ggml update enabling asynchronous host-input copies for split workloads on CUDA. Developers can now queue inputs with set_tensor_async and synchronize once instead of blocking on each copy; other backends retain the existing path, while the async path does not support pipeline parallelism.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加入非同步輸入複製
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI推論框架）更新ggml，在CUDA分割式負載加入非同步主機輸入複製。開發者可非同步複製後一次同步，毋須逐個阻塞複製；其他後端維持舊路徑，管線平行不支援新路徑。非CUDA環境可選其他後端。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp Adds Named Tool Choice and Qwen3-Coder Support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source large language model inference framework, added named tool choice to automatic parsers and support for Qwen3-Coder. Developers can now restrict tool use to a named tool, with parallel calls disabled for that choice.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 加入具名工具選擇
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源語言模型推論框架）為自動解析器加入具名工具選擇，並支援Qwen3-Coder。過往開發者難以指定可用工具，現可限定具名工具並停用並行呼叫，令調用更可控；同類方案可比較模型API的工具綁定功能。

items.headline_en: LobeChat hides unavailable Open Agent entries
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released v0.0.233, which hides the “Open Agent” option when a viewer cannot open an agent. Users no longer see an unusable entry, reducing confusion and misleading clicks.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat 隱藏無法開啟的 Open Agent
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 對話平台）發布 v0.0.233，隱藏檢視者無法開啟的代理之「Open Agent」選項。以前介面可能顯示不可用入口，現在可減少誤點與困惑；同類工具可比較代理權限與入口設計。

items.summary_en: n8n, an open-source workflow automation tool, released 2.49.6 with fixes aligning Base64, URL-encoding, and formatting results from isolate expression engines with legacy behavior, plus native evaluation of urlEncode, base64Decode, and format. Users can handle encoding, decoding, and formatting directly in workflows with fewer workarounds; a similar option is Zapier.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.49.6表達式引擎更新
items.summary_zh: n8n（開源流程自動化工具）2.49.6修正隔離表達式引擎的編碼及格式結果，並原生支援urlEncode、base64Decode與format。用戶可減少繞路方案，可在流程內處理編碼解碼及格式化；同類可選Zapier。

items.headline_en: n8n 2.50.1 aligns expression results
items.summary_en: n8n, a workflow-automation platform for connecting apps and automating tasks, released version 2.50.1 with fixes for Assistant timeline loading, isolated expression engines and node-panel display. Isolated base64, URL-encoding and formatting results now match legacy behavior, while permitted triggers remain separate from restricted nodes, giving users more consistent workflow configuration.
items.headline_zh: n8n 2.50.1 修正運算一致性
items.summary_zh: n8n（自動化工作流程的平台）推出2.50.1，修正Assistant時間線載入。隔離引擎的base64、urlEncode及格式結果由不一致變成與舊版一致，允許的觸發器與受限節點分開，畫面更清楚；同類可選Zapier。

items.headline_en: LobeChat Adds Channel Device Q&A
items.summary_en: LobeChat, an open-source AI chat platform, released CLI v0.0.232 with a Channel feature for asking device Agents questions where they answer. Users can now keep device Agent questions and responses in the same Channel, reducing context switching.
items.headline_zh: LobeChat CLI 加入 Channel 問答
items.summary_zh: LobeChat（開源 AI 平台）發布 CLI v0.0.232，Channel 新增裝置問答，用戶可在 Agent 回答的頻道提問。過往須離開頻道溝通，現在可原地處理，減少切換；可選整合 Agent 的聊天平台。

items.headline_en: Vercel shifts Standard builds for Pro teams to usage billing
items.summary_en: Vercel, a cloud development platform, has moved Standard builds for existing Pro teams to usage-based billing. Teams no longer get an included Standard build slot; they now pay $0.014 per build minute, with monthly usage credit applied to build usage, and can view included and Standard minutes on the Usage page.
items.headline_zh: Vercel Pro 標準建置改按用量收費
items.summary_zh: Vercel（雲端平台）將現有 Pro 團隊的 Standard builds 改為按用量計費，不再附標準建置名額。用戶每分鐘付0.014美元，月度額度可抵扣，亦可在 Usage 頁查看分鐘數；同類 CI/CD 平台亦可比較。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp b12721 fixes MSVC static test builds
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, fixes the MSVC static builds of test-batch-alloc and test-server-component in b12721. Windows developers can now compile and run the affected test targets instead of being blocked by the fixed build error; Ollama offers a similar local-model workflow.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 MSVC 測試建置
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp 是開源本地大型語言模型推理框架，b12721 修正兩項測試的 MSVC 靜態建置錯誤。Windows 開發者過往可能被建置問題卡住，現可較順利編譯及執行測試；同類工具可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: llama.cpp adds Inkling 2 DSpark support
items.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local LLM inference framework, has added support for Inkling 2 DSpark, covering conversion setup, temperature handling, draft-state fixes and draw-order corrections. Users can now use the Inkling 2 draft workflow within an existing llama.cpp setup, reducing the need for separate integration; other DSpark models offer comparable options.
items.headline_zh: llama.cpp 支援 Inkling 2 DSpark
items.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機模型推論框架）新增 Inkling 2 DSpark 支援，涵蓋轉換初始化、溫度、草稿狀態與繪製順序。用戶現可把草稿功能接入既有流程，減少整合工作；同類選擇包括其他 DSpark 模型。

items.headline_en: Cozey Lets Non-Engineers Build Apps on Vercel
items.summary_en: Cozey, a Canadian furniture company, has staff outside engineering—including warehouse, finance and support teams—build and deploy apps on the Vercel developer platform. Finance now reviews profit and loss weekly instead of monthly, making business analysis more timely.
items.headline_zh: Cozey 讓員工用 Vercel 自建應用
items.summary_zh: 加拿大家具公司 Cozey 讓倉務、財務及支援人員用雲端開發平台 Vercel 自建並部署應用，把部分日常工作交給自製工具；財務團隊由每月查閱損益變成每週查看，審視更及時。同類選擇可留意 Replit。

items.headline_en: KoboldCpp Japanese LLM Suite Gets Standalone Release
items.summary_en: KoboldCpp is a local LLM tool, and this Japanese suite offers a standalone Windows 10/11 x64 release with configuration. Users can run a Japanese model locally using the supplied configuration instead of setting everything up themselves; the repository gained 118 GitHub stars in one day, while Ollama is a similar local-LLM option.
items.headline_zh: KoboldCpp 日語 LLM 套件新增獨立版

items.headline_en: OpenRouter adds a November 25 changelog entry
items.summary_en: OpenRouter added a changelog entry dated November 25, 2026, but the provided source does not specify what changed.
items.headline_zh: OpenRouter新增11月25日更新記錄
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter（統一接入多種AI模型的平台）新增2026年11月25日更新記錄。過往未有這則記錄，而家可按日期查閱；但來源未列明功能改動，暫時無法判斷實際效益。同類選擇可留意LiteLLM

items.headline_en: Inkling 2 Mini Runs Hill-climbing Inference on One RTX PRO 6000
items.summary_en: Inkling 2 Mini, an AI model featured by Hugging Face Blog, runs hill-climbing inference on a single RTX PRO 6000. The setup offers users a single-workstation-GPU way to test the approach without assembling a multi-GPU rig; similar single-GPU inference methods can serve as alternatives.
items.headline_zh: Inkling 2 Mini 單卡推理實驗
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face Blog（模型平台）展示 Inkling 2 Mini 模型的 hill-climbing 推理，僅用單張 RTX PRO 6000。用戶能以單卡工作站試跑，毋須搭建多卡環境；同類單卡推理方案可比較。

items.headline_en: Introducing Hurdle: Run agent evals on your API, skills, and docs
items.summary_en: Hurdle is an open-source npm library for agent evals. Run Claude Code and Codex against real tasks on your API, score each run with code checks, guards and an LLM judge, and see which models and conditions pass.

items.headline_en: Workflow is 10x faster, again
items.summary_en: Workflow SDK 5.8 runs workflows on a new execution engine, rebuilt for performance. Step-to-step latency is 12x lower, and large fan-outs, like running 256 steps in parallel, use 14x less function time outside your step code. This directly improves turn times for durable AI agents, among many other improvements.To get the new engine, upgrade to workflow@5.8.0 or later. New runs will use the new engine by default, and runs already started on an older version will safely keep running on that versi

items.headline_en: All Vercel Sandbox runtimes use managed images
items.summary_en: Vercel Sandbox, a cloud code-isolation runtime, now uses Vercel Managed Images (VMIs) for every runtime. New sandboxes give developers 64 GB of storage and a consistent Vercel Container Registry setup, while legacy node22 uses open-source images from the vercel/sandbox repository.
items.headline_zh: Vercel Sandbox 全面採用 VMI
items.summary_zh: Vercel Sandbox（雲端隔離環境）全面改用 Vercel Managed Images。沙盒沿用 VCR 架構，提供 64GB 儲存；舊 runtime 統一用開源映像，設定一致。同類如 Docker 沙盒。

items.headline_en: AI AutoCut
items.summary_en: AI Video AutoCut brings video handling and cutting together in one tool. Users can complete both steps in one place instead of switching tools; the repository shows 66 GitHub stars in the tracked period.
items.headline_zh: AI Video AutoCut 影片剪輯工具
items.summary_zh: AI Video AutoCut 是 GitHub 上的 AI 影片剪輯專案，將影片處理與剪輯整合在同一工具；以往要分開操作，現在可集中完成流程，省下切換工具的時間。同類選擇可看 CapCut。

items.headline_en: AI Stream AutoClipper Combines Streaming and Clipping
items.summary_en: AI Stream AutoClipper is a GitHub tool that combines livestreaming with automatic clipping. Creators can manage both in one tool instead of separate workflows, and it gained 66 GitHub stars in its first day.
items.headline_zh: AI Stream AutoClipper直播剪輯合一
items.summary_zh: AI Stream AutoClipper係GitHub上的AI直播剪輯工具，整合直播與影片切片。用戶毋須來回切換直播與剪輯流程，內容整理更直接。同類直播方案亦可比較OBS。

items.headline_en: AI Auto Subtitles: Two Features, One Tool
items.summary_en: AI Auto Subtitles is a GitHub repository that combines subtitle functionality and automatic features in one tool. Users can keep related work in one place instead of switching between separate tools; the repository gained 66 GitHub stars, with a listed pace of roughly 132 per day.
items.headline_zh: AI Auto Subtitles整合自動字幕
items.summary_zh: AI Auto Subtitles（結合字幕與自動功能的GitHub工具）可把相關工作集中處理，讓用戶少在多個工具間切換；榜單記錄66個星標，增速約每日132個。同類選擇可留意Whisper。

items.headline_en: Remix Reels
items.summary_en: The GitHub project ai-reels-remix lets creators remix other people's Reels with voice swaps, subtitles, and background changes. This can simplify a workflow that previously required editing each element manually, and the repository gained 66 GitHub stars in its first day.
items.headline_zh: ai-reels-remix 混音 Reels
items.summary_zh: ai-reels-remix 係 GitHub 上嘅短片重混工具，可將其他人 Reels 換聲、加字幕及更換背景。過往要逐項做後期，現時可用工具完成重混；亦可考慮 CapCut 等短片編輯器。

items.headline_en: Voiceover studio: 50+ voices, cloning, emotions, lip-sync.
items.summary_en: ShirleyRodrigues6287/dubbing-studio - Voiceover studio: 50+ voices, cloning, emotions, lip-sync. | ai voiceover voiceover voices clone emotions | Portable x64 prebuilt for Windows Gained 66 GitHub stars in 1 days (~55/day).

items.headline_en: AI Game Coach Analyzes Replays
items.summary_en: AI Game Coach is a GitHub project that analyzes game replays to provide tips and identify mistake patterns. It can reduce the need to scrub through replays manually to diagnose errors, and the repository has gained 66 GitHub stars at roughly 132 per day.
items.headline_zh: AI Game Coach 分析對局重播
items.summary_zh: AI Game Coach（GitHub 遊戲分析專案）可分析對局重播、提供提示，並找出失誤模式。玩家毋須逐段重看錄影找問題，可更快掌握改善方向；專案已有66個GitHub stars，同類選擇可比較其他AI對局分析工具。

items.headline_en: AI Turns Posts Into Vertical Videos
items.summary_en: The GitHub project Nancy0425/tweet-video-ai turns tweets and posts into vertical videos with AI voiceovers. It offers a portable x64 build for Windows, letting users create the video and narration together instead of assembling both separately; it gained 49 GitHub stars in one day, while CapCut is a similar video-creation option.
items.headline_zh: tweet-video-ai 轉貼文為直式影片
items.summary_zh: tweet-video-ai（GitHub 專案）可把推文、貼文配 AI 旁白，轉成直式影片。Windows x64 便攜版讓用戶毋須分開製作影片與配音；一天獲 49 個星標，同類可選 CapCut。

items.headline_en: Voicebox Qwen3 TTS Studio Now Portable
items.summary_en: Voicebox Qwen3 TTS Studio now offers a standalone Windows 10/11 (x64) portable release with a configuration suite. Users can run and configure the text-to-speech studio without a conventional installation; the repository gained 108 GitHub stars in its first day.
items.headline_zh: Voicebox Qwen3 TTS便攜版發布
items.summary_zh: Voicebox Qwen3 TTS Studio（文字轉語音工具）推出 Windows 便攜版及設定套件。過往同類程式多要安裝，現時可直接開啟配置，減少試用搬移步驟。首日獲108個GitHub星；便攜語音工具可比較。

items.headline_en: Faceless channel pipeline: topic in, finished video with voice and subtitles out.
items.summary_en: ferrari4050/yt-autopilot - Faceless channel pipeline: topic in, finished video with voice and subtitles out. | ai faceless youtube channel auto video | Portable x64 prebuilt for Windows Gained 48 GitHub stars in 1 days (~43/day).

items.headline_en: post-to-video turns posts into vertical videos
items.summary_en: post-to-video is a GitHub tool that turns tweets and posts into vertical videos with AI voiceover. For creators, its portable x64 build for Windows lets them repurpose posts; CapCut is a similar alternative.
items.headline_zh: post-to-video 將貼文變直式影片
items.summary_zh: post-to-video 係 GitHub 工具，可將貼文轉成帶 AI 旁白嘅直式影片。以往要另覓影片工具，現在可用 Windows 便攜 x64 版轉片；同類可選 CapCut。

items.headline_en: AI Faceless Video Pipeline Adds Voice and Subtitles
items.summary_en: Sabine12168/ai-faceless-channel is a GitHub pipeline that turns a topic into a finished video with voice and subtitles. For creators, this streamlines a manual topic-to-video workflow through a portable Windows x64 build; the repository gained 63 stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: ai-faceless-channel 自動成片
items.summary_zh: ai-faceless-channel 係 GitHub 上嘅無臉影片專案，可將主題變成有旁白同字幕嘅完成影片。以前要製作、配音及加字幕，而家可用 Windows x64 預編譯版自動處理。同類可選 Descript。

items.headline_en: Outcome per dollar is the frontier. We’re advancing it at every layer: FLOPs-efficient pretraining (MAI Base 2), long RL climbs (Rocket), and token-efficient models (7 new MAI models announced last we
items.summary_en: The post Outcome per dollar is the frontier. We’re advancing it at every layer: FLOPs-efficient pretraining (MAI Base 2), long RL climbs (Rocket), and token-efficient models (7 new MAI models announced last week) [Read more] appeared first on Source .

items.headline_en: Microduck Adds Sim2Real Obstacle Avoidance
items.summary_en: Microduck is a robotics project using Isaac Lab and Newton for a Sim2Real obstacle-avoidance workflow. Developers can follow its path from simulation to a physical robot, rather than building the workflow from scratch.
items.headline_zh: Microduck 展示模擬到實機避障流程
items.summary_zh: Microduck（避障機器人）推出 Sim2Real 流程，利用 Isaac Lab 與 Newton 模擬，再把設定帶到實機。開發者可參考由模擬驗證到實機測試的做法，節省建立流程的時間；同類工作亦可用 MuJoCo。

items.headline_en: Copilot restored
items.summary_en: Microsoft Copilot, the AI assistant, has returned to normal after an earlier service issue. Users can resume regular use without the interruption; ChatGPT is another AI-assistant option.
items.headline_zh: Copilot服務狀態已恢復正常
items.summary_zh: Microsoft Copilot（微軟AI助理）早前服務異常，現已回復正常，所有系統均運作中。用戶可如常使用，不再受先前中斷影響；替代方案亦可考慮ChatGPT等AI助理

items.headline_en: AI Selects Graphics for Your Hardware
items.summary_en: The GitHub project game-settings-optimizer uses AI to select graphics settings suited to a user's hardware. This saves players from testing each option manually and finding a suitable balance themselves.
items.headline_zh: AI 按硬件配對遊戲畫質
items.summary_zh: game-settings-optimizer 係 GitHub AI 工具，按硬件揀合適嘅遊戲畫質選項。以前要逐項試校，而家可自動配對，慳返調校時間；上架即日已獲 66 stars。想自行控制，可改用遊戲內手動設定。

items.headline_en: AI boot scan
items.summary_en: The GitHub project startup-tuner uses AI to identify what slows system startup and recommends safe items to disable. This gives users a focused list instead of manually checking every startup entry, and the repository has 62 GitHub stars.
items.headline_zh: AI 開機掃描器找出慢項
items.summary_zh: startup-tuner（GitHub 上的 AI 開機優化工具）會找出拖慢系統啟動的項目，並建議安全停用部分項目。用戶毋須逐項手動排查，可更快鎖定要調整的開機項目；想自行處理，作業系統的開機應用程式設定亦可。

items.headline_en: Copilot AI model providers report degraded performance
items.summary_en: Copilot’s status page reports minor degraded performance from its AI model providers. If responses feel slow, users can check the status page before rewriting prompts, making it easier to distinguish a provider issue from a prompt issue.
items.headline_zh: Copilot AI 模型供應商效能降級
items.summary_zh: Copilot（AI 程式碼助理）的狀態頁顯示，AI 模型供應商出現輕微效能降級。用戶若遇回應變慢，可先查狀態頁，免急於反覆改寫提示詞，更易分辨服務問題抑或自身輸入。用同類 AI 服務時，亦可先查其狀態頁。

items.headline_en: AI VTuber Toolkit Creates Live Avatars
items.summary_en: QujoziVe5's ai-vtuber-toolkit turns a user's face into a live VTuber avatar with AI voiceover and automatic reactions, and provides a prebuilt portable x64 build for Windows. Streamers can combine face tracking, speech and reactions without developing each feature themselves; the repository gained 66 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: AI VTuber 工具可建立即時虛擬角色
items.summary_zh: ai-vtuber-toolkit 是 VTuber 直播工具，可把人臉變成即時角色，配 AI 配音及自動反應。以前要自行開發追蹤、語音功能，現在有 Windows x64 便攜版可用；首日獲 66 星。同類可選 VSeeFace。

items.headline_en: VTuber Kit
items.summary_en: VTuber Kit is a GitHub project that turns a user's face into a live avatar with AI voiceover and automatic reactions. The portable x64 Windows build gives streamers a prebuilt way to combine face tracking, TTS and reactions instead of assembling them separately; the repository gained 65 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: VTuber Kit：AI 虛擬主播工具
items.summary_zh: VTuber Kit 是 AI 虛擬主播工具，可把臉部轉成即時角色，並加入 AI 配音及自動反應。Windows 用戶可用預先編譯的 x64 版本，毋須自行整合追蹤、TTS 與表情；同類追蹤亦可比較 VSeeFace。

items.headline_en: AI Driver Tool Tests Compatibility and Rolls Back
items.summary_en: TujoseYora24/driver-tool-ai is a GitHub tool that uses AI to find outdated drivers, test compatibility, and safely roll back updates; the project gained 63 GitHub stars in the tracked period. Instead of checking drivers manually, users can rely on automated compatibility tests and a recovery path after a failed update, while built-in system update tools remain a manual alternative.
items.headline_zh: driver-tool-ai 測相容性並安全回滾
items.summary_zh: driver-tool-ai（GitHub AI 驅動工具）可找過期驅動程式、測相容性並安全回滾，追蹤期獲63個GitHub stars。過往要逐一手動處理，現可自動查找、測試兼復原；另一選擇是系統內建更新工具。

items.headline_en: AI Driver Updater Checks Compatibility and Rolls Back
items.summary_en: The GitHub project driver-updater-pro uses AI to find outdated drivers, test compatibility, and safely roll back updates. For users, this reduces manual version checking and provides a recovery path when an update fails.
items.headline_zh: driver-updater-pro 安全回滾
items.summary_zh: driver-updater-pro：GitHub AI 驅動更新工具，可找過期驅動、測試相容性，出錯能安全回滾。用戶從前要自行比對、復原，而家工具檢查兼留退路；同類如 Snappy Driver Installer。

items.headline_en: Biosignal-guided reinforcement learning for LLM agents: offline organoid neural recordings as policy inputs in
items.summary_en: brainintelli/BioSignal-Guided-LLM-Reinforcement-Learning - Biosignal-guided reinforcement learning for LLM agents: offline organoid neural recordings as policy inputs in a Godot survival game, with paired evaluation. Gained 148 GitHub stars in 2 days (~72/day).

items.headline_en: Vercel Adds AWS PrivateLink to Secure Compute
items.summary_en: Vercel Secure Compute, a service for connecting project environments to a dedicated VPC, now supports AWS PrivateLink endpoints. Enterprise teams can now create and manage them directly in the Vercel dashboard, while connected Vercel Functions, Sandbox, and builds reach AWS-hosted backends; AWS Direct Connect is a comparable option.
items.headline_zh: Vercel支援AWS PrivateLink
items.summary_zh: Vercel Secure Compute（供專案接入專屬VPC）支援AWS PrivateLink端點。團隊可於控制台建立及管理，讓連接環境存取AWS後端，毋須分開設定；可比較AWS Direct Connect。

items.headline_en: Local AI Chat
items.summary_en: local-ai-chat-uncensored is a Windows AI chat app that runs on your own machine, provides uncensored conversations, and does not phone home. Instead of relying on a cloud chat service, users can run the portable x64 build locally for private conversations; it gained 52 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: 本機無濾鏡 AI 聊天工具
items.summary_zh: 這款 Windows 本機 AI 聊天工具可直接在電腦上對話，資料不需傳往雲端。過往依賴雲端聊天服務的用戶，現可下載預先打包的 x64 版本，私密進行無濾鏡交流；同類本機 AI 選擇可考慮 Ollama。

items.headline_en: LLM Key Pool
items.summary_en: llm-key-pool is a GitHub project that provides one endpoint for every free LLM API key a user owns. Developers can use a single endpoint for all their free LLM keys instead of handling each separately; the repository gained 51 GitHub stars in 0 days.
items.headline_zh: llm-key-pool 單一LLM API端點
items.summary_zh: llm-key-pool 是 GitHub 專案，把用戶手上的免費 LLM API 金鑰接到同一端點。開發者毋須逐一把金鑰分開處理，能經單一介面呼叫；專案首日錄得 51 個星號。同類選擇可看 LiteLLM。

items.headline_en: Claude Code Sessions Rotate Automatically
items.summary_en: claude-code-unlimited is a GitHub tool that automatically rotates Claude Code sessions. It spares users from manually opening a new session after reaching a limit, and the repository gained 68 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: Claude Code 會話自動輪換
items.summary_zh: claude-code-unlimited 係 GitHub 上嘅 Claude Code 工具，可自動輪替會話。以前撞上限要手動開新會話，而家可自動輪換，減少工作中斷。另一選擇係手動重開會話。

items.headline_en: ccu-tool Rotates Claude Code Sessions
items.summary_en: ccu-tool is a portable Windows x64 command-line utility that automatically rotates Claude Code sessions. It saves users from manually rotating sessions when a usage limit is reached; the project gained 57 GitHub stars in one day.
items.headline_zh: Claude Code 自動輪換會話
items.summary_zh: ccu-tool 是 Windows 命令列工具，可自動輪換 Claude Code 會話，減少用量受限造成的影響。用戶毋須手動切換，操作更省心；一日獲 57 個 GitHub 星號。同類選擇還有手動輪換會話。

items.headline_en: Amazon Bedrock adds trusted access API
items.summary_en: Amazon Bedrock, AWS's managed foundation-model platform, now offers a trusted access API for discovering, requesting, and enrolling in model-provider programs. Its first public-preview offerings are Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls, giving users one place to manage access and more control over data used with Claude Fable models.
items.headline_zh: Amazon Bedrock 新增信任接入 API
items.summary_zh: Amazon Bedrock 係 AWS 嘅模型服務平台，新增嘅信任接入 API 可集中查找、申請同登記模型供應商計劃。公開預覽首批支援 Anthropic 嘅 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards 同 Enterprise Data Controls；以前要逐項處理，而家可經一個入口管理，並控制使用 Claude Fable 模型時嘅數據。其他模型供應商嘅計劃亦循同一途徑接入。

items.headline_en: Workflow SDK adds on-demand run data deletion
items.summary_en: Vercel's Workflow SDK, a toolkit for building workflow applications, can now delete a completed run's stored data on demand. Teams can purge inputs, outputs, hook payloads and error traces to meet compliance and security requirements, while the run's metadata remains.
items.headline_zh: Workflow SDK可按需刪除執行資料
items.summary_zh: Vercel Workflow SDK（工作流程SDK）可按需刪除已完成執行的輸入、輸出、掛鉤資料及錯誤追蹤。過往因應合規與保安要求，團隊要另行處理敏感內容；現可快速清除，並保留執行中繼資料。同類 SDK 可比較。

items.headline_en: Flags SDK now works on Vercel without FLAGS_SECRET
items.summary_en: With flags@4.5.0, projects on Vercel can use Flags Explorer and precompute without FLAGS_SECRET. That cuts out a setup step for new projects and removes the need to keep a shared secret in sync across microfrontends. Vercel signs Flags Explorer discovery requests and overrides, and the SDK encrypts flag values shown in the Vercel Toolbar with Vercel’s public key.Existing projects keep using FLAGS_SECRET while the environment variable is set or the secret is passed in code. items.summary_en: Your agent can now manage AI Gateway through Vercel MCP. items.headline_en: Qwen4-Max input price rises
items.summary_en: Together AI’s Qwen4-Max API, which provides access to a large language model, raised its input price from $1.05 to $1.50 per 1 million tokens—a 42.9% increase—according to the LiteLLM Price Registry. Developers can recalculate expected spend before the next bill and compare alternative model APIs if needed.
items.headline_zh: Qwen4-Max API輸入費升43%
items.summary_zh: Together AI的Qwen4-Max語言模型API，LiteLLM顯示每百萬輸入token費用由1.05美元升至1.50美元，升42.9%。開發者可核對用量、調整預算，免致超支；如改用其他模型，也可比較API收費。

items.headline_en: Qwen4-Max Output Price Rises 43%
items.summary_en: Together AI's Qwen4-Max API output tokens now cost $4.50 per 1 million, up from $3.15, according to the LiteLLM Price Registry. Developers using the API for high-volume generation may see higher bills and should check their expected usage before the next billing cycle.
items.headline_zh: Qwen4-Max 輸出價格上調 43%
items.summary_zh: Together AI 的 Qwen4-Max API 是按 token 收費的文字生成服務。LiteLLM 價格資料顯示，每百萬個輸出 token 由 3.15 美元升至 4.50 美元，升幅約 42.9%；用量大的用戶下次帳單可能增加。其他文字生成 API 都是同類選擇。

items.headline_en: Claude Reports Service Degradation
items.summary_en: Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) is experiencing partially degraded service, according to its status page. Users seeing unusual behavior should check the status page before blaming their prompts and may retry later.
items.headline_zh: Claude 部分服務降級
items.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic 的人工智能助理）可協助處理文字任務，官方狀態頁現顯示服務部分降級。用戶遇到異常時，與其先反覆修改提示詞，可先查看狀態頁並稍後再試；同類選擇可考慮 ChatGPT。

items.headline_en: Windows 与 macOS 的 3D 桌面小猫桌宠：响应全局键鼠、敲键追光标、摸猫呼噜；支持照片取色或 AI（内置 MCP）定制专属猫咪，闲置后睡觉。
items.summary_en: 7wdn/7paws - Windows 与 macOS 的 3D 桌面小猫桌宠：响应全局键鼠、敲键追光标、摸猫呼噜；支持照片取色或 AI（内置 MCP）定制专属猫咪，闲置后睡觉。 Gained 78 GitHub stars in 3 days (~84/day).
